subject: Naked mole-rat cGAS rewires DNA repair: four amino acids that slow aging
script: From Agewell Brief: Naked mole-rat cGAS rewires DNA repair: four amino acids that slow aging. A new study reveals how naked mole-rats evade a suppressive function of cGAS to enhance homologous recombination repair, offering a precise molecular lever for lifespan extension. Four amino acid changes in naked mole-rat cGAS weaken TRIM41 ubiquitination and P97 extraction. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
